profile.title: Profile
profile.displayNameHint: Shown in the menu instead of your email address. Leave it empty to use the address.
profile.timezoneHint: Dates and times in Bantoozi are shown in this time zone.

preferences.title: Reading preferences
preferences.intro: Each change is saved as soon as you make it.

lock.title: Preferences are being adjusted in another tab or window
lock.body: Changes are paused here so that two windows do not overwrite each other. Choose Edit here instead to continue in this window.

defaultTier.label: Minimum tier
defaultTier.hint: Hides articles below this tier in For you and Maybe. Tier 1 shows everything, tier 5 only the strongest matches.

sort.label: Order of For you
sort.hint: Best match lists the articles most likely to interest you first. Newest first goes by publication date.

hideEverything.label: Hide the Everything else lane
hideEverything.hint: Removes the lane of articles that match none of your interests from the sidebar. Nothing is deleted.

simpleMode.label: Simple mode
simpleMode.hint: Lists show titles only, with no excerpts and no thumbnails.

markReadOnExpand.label: Mark as read when I open an article
markReadOnExpand.hint: An article you expand in a list counts as read.

markReadOnRate.label: Mark as read when I rate an article
markReadOnRate.hint: Giving an article a thumbs up or down also marks it as read.

implicitFeedback.label: Learn from how I read
implicitFeedback.hint: Off by default. When on, Bantoozi times how long you stay away after opening an article's original page and learns from it. Thumbs up, thumbs down and bookmarks teach Bantoozi without it.

implicitNegative.label: Count marking as read without opening as not interested
implicitNegative.hint: Counts only while Learn from how I read is on, and only when you mark an article as read yourself without opening it.

feedbackPrompt.label: Feedback prompts
feedbackPrompt.hint: How often Bantoozi asks “Did you like it?” when you come back from reading an article elsewhere. It asks only while Learn from how I read is on.

exampleSuggestions.label: Suggest teaching an interest after a rating
exampleSuggestions.hint: After you rate an article, offer to add it as an example to the interest that matched it. Nothing changes unless you accept.

quality.intro: Auto turns a filter on after you dislike three articles for that reason within 90 days. On always applies it. Off never does.

clickbait.label: Clickbait
clickbait.hint: Ranks articles with headlines that promise more than the article delivers lower.

promotional.label: Promotional articles
promotional.hint: Ranks adverts and sales pitches lower.

shallow.label: Shallow articles
shallow.hint: Ranks thin articles with little depth lower.

stale.label: Stale news
stale.hint: Ranks time-sensitive stories older than three days lower.

left.label: Swipe left
left.hint: What happens when you swipe an article to the left on a touch screen.

right.label: Swipe right
right.hint: What happens when you swipe an article to the right on a touch screen.

images.label: Load images from publishers' websites
images.hint: Off by default. Loading an image tells that website you are reading its article. A feed can have its own setting, listed below.
images.exceptions: Feeds with their own image setting
images.none: No feed has its own image setting.
images.unknownFeed: A feed you no longer follow

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: The devices where you are signed in. Revoke any you don't recognise.

other.title: Revoke this session?
other.body: That device will be signed out and has to sign in again.

current.title: Sign out of this device?
current.body: You will be signed out here and taken to the sign-in page.

invites.title: Invites
invites.description: Invite people to Bantoozi. Each invite can be used once and is valid for 30 days.
invites.empty: You have not created an invite yet.
invites.copyFailed: Couldn't copy the link automatically. Select it here and copy it: {{url}}

form.title: Create an invite
form.emailHint: We email the invite to this address, and only this address can use it.
form.noteHint: Stored with the invite. It isn't included in the email.

result.title: New invite
result.emailFailed: The email could not be sent. Share the link yourself.

export.title: Export your data
export.description: Download everything Bantoozi holds about you as one JSON file: your profile, subscriptions, interests, labels, rules, ratings and saved articles.
export.http: The server could not prepare your export (error {{status}}). Try again.
export.network: The download was interrupted. Check your connection and try again.
export.incomplete: The file arrived incomplete, so nothing was saved. Try again.
export.rateLimited_one: You've asked for your data too often. Try again in {{count}} minute.
export.rateLimited_other: You've asked for your data too often. Try again in {{count}} minutes.
export.rateLimitedLater: You've asked for your data too often. Try again later.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.explain: Deleting your account signs you out on every device and closes it. You have 7 days to change your mind: sign in again within 7 days to restore everything. After that your data is deleted for good.

dialog.title: Delete your account?
dialog.body: This signs you out everywhere. Sign in again within 7 days to restore your account. After that it is deleted for good.
dialog.unsent_one: {{count}} change has not been sent yet and will be lost.
dialog.unsent_other: {{count}} changes have not been sent yet and will be lost.

delete.done: Your account is deleted. Sign in again within 7 days to restore it.
